tokens.name: qualys-blue
tokens.usage: Qualys Blue · Blue-300 (Primary). Links, eyebrows, feature icons, icon containers, focus ring, card hover bar, blue surfaces. 3.78:1 on white, 3.65:1 on warm-off-white, 3.50:1 on ecru — enough for 24px+ (or 18.66px bold) text, icons and borders; small blue text falls short of 4.5:1 (use cobalt where that matters). White on it 3.78:1.

tokens.name: qualys-red
tokens.usage: Qualys Red · Red-100 (Primary). Primary buttons, button text links, the logo shield. White label on it 4.18:1 and as text 4.18:1 on white / 4.04:1 on warm-off-white — just under 4.5:1 for labels below 18.66px bold.

tokens.name: charcoal

tokens.name: polar-blue

tokens.name: warm-off-white

tokens.name: ecru

tokens.name: linen

tokens.name: ash
